description: Label by MBID: type (Original Production, Reissue, Imprint, …), country, life span, label code (the LC number), area, aliases, tags, and external links (url-rels — Wikidata, Discogs, official site). A label's releases are a potentially huge linked set (a major label can have tens of thousands), so they are NOT embedded here — enumerate them with musicbrainz_browse_entities (target_type=release, link.label).
name: musicbrainz_get_label

items.description: An alternate name for the entity.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale of the alias. Omitted when absent.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary alias for its locale. Omitted when absent.

sortName.description: Sortable form of the alias. Omitted when absent.

type.description: Alias type (e.g. "Artist name", "Legal name"). Omitted when absent.

area.description: Associated area name. Omitted when unknown.

country.description: ISO country code. Omitted when unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no label exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: An external resource link (url-rel). Where cross-service IDs like Wikidata QID are surfaced.

resource.description: The external URL. Wikidata/Discogs IDs live in the URL path — chain to those servers.

labelCode.description: Label code (LC number), without the "LC" prefix. Omitted when absent.

begin.description: Start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when unknown.

ended.description: Whether the entity has ended. Omitted when the upstream value is unknown/null.

sortName.description: Sortable name form. Omitted when absent.

items.description: A folksonomy tag or genre with its vote count.

count.description: Community vote count for this tag.
